english.title: Possess a category 4 firework when not an exempt person
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had in your possession a Category 4 firework as defined by regulation 3 of the Fireworks Regulations 2004, namely a **(..SPECIFY THE FIREWORK..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 5 of the Fireworks Regulations 2004 and section 11(1) and (4) of the Fireworks Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
possessed a Category 4 firework
when you were not exempt from such possession

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - DA14 but as from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

(i) The Penalty Notice for Disorder was raised from £80 to £90 on 01/07/13
(ii) See regulation 6 for the exemptions.
(iii) See regulation 3 for a definition of a category 4 firework.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Penalty Notice for Disorder - Ninety Pounds.

Note:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months (see regulation 13 of the Fireworks Regulations 2004)

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
